name: B10-0240/2026 (The Left) – Implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This text is an opinion, not a new law. It asks the European Union to keep its rules on cleaning medicines and cosmetics out of wastewater. Under those rules, drug and cosmetics companies pay most of the cost of removing these residues. The text rejects claims that this causes medicine shortages and says the cost to medicine prices is tiny. It also asks to extend the same payment system to pesticides later.

**Key points**

- Companies making medicines and cosmetics keep paying at least 80% of the extra water cleaning.
- It affects these companies, water bills, and national governments running the system.
- The European Commission must review the rules by 2033 and 2040.
